_comment: Copy to config.json. This server runs on the machine that HOLDS THE LIBRARIES (ubuntuserver) and drives GPU hosts over ssh. It never upscales anything itself.
_bind_comment: The TAILSCALE IP, not 127.0.0.1. Caddy runs in a container, so its loopback is not this host's - a service on 127.0.0.1 is unreachable to it. Native services here bind the tailnet address for exactly this reason (dashboard :8443, copyparty :3923). The address is CGNAT and not routable from the internet.
_upscale_bin_comment: ABSOLUTE. A systemd --user service has no ~/.local/bin on its PATH, so a bare "upscale" resolves to nothing and every library reports an error.
_media_root_comment: Scanned one level deep for libraries. A directory counts as a library when it holds video files, so a new show appears without editing this file.
_hosts_comment: Add a rented box the same way once it exists; `ssh` is whatever reaches it (an alias, or '-p 48726 root@1.2.3.4').

src_ext._comment: per-library source extension; anything unlisted uses the default
